# Vendored WebTUI

Unmodified base, box and typography styles from `@webtui/css` 0.1.10.

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@webtui/css/-/css-0.1.10.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/webtui/webtui

CSS usage: https://webtui.ironclad.sh/start/installation/

The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE. Local styles allow offline viewing without a CDN.
